terms.gloss: an informer; one who points out
evidence: Cic. Mur. 49: Catilīnam vallātum indicibus atque sīcāriīs (Lewis & Short)
Lewis & Short s.v. dēlātor: only post-Augustan, Tac., Suet.

phrases.latin: Vīdit et perfossōrem et indicem ējus.
phrases.english: He saw the burglar and his lookout man.

sources: Lewis & Short: index · Lewis & Short: delator
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 192–196.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
